item.text: I’m checking the reconstructed filing for the cover-page share count and will pull the exact figure from the JSON text.
`rg` isn’t available here, so I’m using a quick parser to search the filing text directly and extract the cover-page line with the share count.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json, re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/LOCKHEEDMARTIN_2022_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts',[])
patterns=[r'shares of common stock', r'outstanding as of', r'cover-page', r'Common stock']
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    text=t.get('text','')
    if any(re.search(p, text, re.I) for p in patterns):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',repr(text[:500]))
PY"
